pages.text: $(thing)Create Integrated Farming$() adds farming machines for contraptions: a Vacuum Harvester, Roosts for poultry, and Fishing Nets that fish while moving. Several recipes use Farmer's Delight items.

pages.title: Vacuum Harvester
pages.text: Rotation charges its chamber (30 s at 64 RPM by default). At full pressure it harvests every mature crop around it at once. Take output from any side but the shaft.

On a contraption the chamber charges on a timer, even while parked. Each pulse covers the whole area around its position. Contraption Controls can pause it.$(br2)See $(l:create_basics/contraptions)Contraptions$(/l).

pages.title: Roost
pages.text: Right-click a bird with an empty Roost to catch it, or lead one in. Poultry produce over time; feeding speeds it up, by hand, belt or Arm.

pages.title: Fishing Net
pages.text: Made from Farmer's Delight's Safety Net. When moved on a contraption it fishes in open water like a rod, and it also catches small animals.

Mechanical Arms can harvest lily pads and powdery crops. A Spout speeds up Organic Compost decay, which feeds Farmer's Delight's Rich Soil.$(br2)Animals: $(l:food/animals)Animals$(/l). Delight basics: $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l).
